title: Manager, Market Access
jobDescription: ROLE SUMMARY The Manager - Market Access will shape and execute access strategies across both public and private healthcare ecosystems. The role demands deep understanding of India's public health and reimbursement pathways, along with strong capability in creating access partnerships in the private sector to unlock innovative therapies and accelerate adult vaccination uptake. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Public Health & Reimbursement Strategy Lead detailed mapping of reimbursement accounts (CARE, state schemes, ESIC, CGHS) including coverage, patient pathways, budgets, procurement systems, and decision-making frameworks. Develop and implement strategies to secure reimbursement, formulary inclusion, and funding across national and state health programs. Identify and activate opportunities within public health programs, disease verticals, and government procurement channels. 2. Access Partnerships – Private Sector (Innovative Therapies & Adult Vaccination) Build and implement access partnerships with private hospitals, multispecialty chains, HCP networks, diagnostic groups, employer health programs, and preventive health platforms. Design innovative access models (affordability programs, pathway creation, capability building, patient support solutions) for innovative therapies and specialty products. Develop and scale adult vaccination pathways through collaboration with vaccination centers, occupational health programs, insurers, TPAs, and corporate health partners. Support value articulation and institutional engagement to drive adoption in the private sector. 3. Health Economics & Evidence Strategy Support development and use of cost-effectiveness models, budget impact analyses, burden-of-disease insights, and value-based evidence to guide payer and provider decisions. Translate evidence into tailored value narratives for government authorities, public payer bodies, private hospitals, and HCP stakeholders. Monitor HTA trends and ensure strategic alignment with emerging value assessment requirements. 4. Policy Intelligence & Market Shaping Continuously track public and private sector policy reforms, reimbursement changes, and health financing trends. Identify implications of policy shifts on access potential and recommend strategic actions. Build internal frameworks to anticipate and respond to changes in the healthcare ecosystem. 5. Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain strong relationships with government authorities, public health program managers, payer institutions, hospital leadership, clinicians, and vaccination ecosystem partners. Collaborate closely with Medical, Government Affairs, Commercial, HEOR, Regulatory, and Supply Chain teams to deliver integrated access objectives. QUALIFICATIONS Science graduate & MBA with 5-12 years of experience of working in Market Access managing key accounts. Knowledge and experience of BIM, COE, Cost benefit models will be preferred. Good understanding stake holders, systems and process of Central and state reimbursement accounts. Leading in matrix organization within and above country teams Ability to understand, synthesize and communicate clinical benefits from public health perspective. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Marketing, Medical, Finance, New product team, KAM, Government affairs, Pricing, leadership team, Pricing leads, Global Access and Strategic Pricing & other GAV stake holders. The role acts as a strategic quality business partner to Pfizer India as a core Leadership Team (LT) member, Global supply chain, and external partners, translating global quality requirements into effective local execution. The SOQ Lead will be accountable for the implementation and compliance to SOQ Functional and Global SOPs and any other Pfizer Quality Standard requirements. It will be the primary contact point for business partners both internal and external. It will be responsible for the management of the SOQ India development and organisation of the team reporting into it. It will also be accountable for the supply of compliant product into India and neighbouring markets and act as a GMP/GDP Compliance role model for areas of responsibility by educating the team and ensuring adherence to Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice for Medicinal Products. title: Associate Manager - Indirect Taxation
jobDescription: At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients. The Sr. Associate – Indirect Taxation will be responsible for hands‑on management and execution of Indirect Tax matters in India, primarily covering GST, Customs, and EOU‑related compliances, for a large multinational pharmaceutical organization with manufacturing and R&D operations. The role will support the Taxation Lead and act as a key operational owner for Indirect Tax compliance, audits, reconciliations, litigation support, and regulatory interactions. The incumbent will be accountable for timely and accurate GST return filings, reconciliations, assessments, appeals, and departmental representations, while ensuring compliance with evolving tax laws and internal controls. This role requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and hands‑on execution capability, along with the ability to interact independently with tax authorities, auditors, internal stakeholders, and external consultants. The position partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Global Tax, and external advisors to ensure compliant and efficient Indirect Tax operations. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. GST Compliance & Return Management · Prepare, review, and file monthly, quarterly, and annual GST returns, including GSTR‑1, GSTR‑3B, GSTR‑2B reconciliations, and annual returns. · Perform detailed reconciliations between GST returns, books of accounts, and e‑way bills; identify mismatches and ensure timely corrective actions. · Monitor GST credit eligibility, utilization, reversals, and ensure accurate accounting and reporting of GST balances. · Track changes in GST law and ensure timely implementation of statutory and procedural updates. 2. GST Audits, Assessments & Litigation Support · Handle GST departmental audits, assessments, and inspections, including preparation of data, reconciliations, and supporting documentation. · Appear before GST authorities for hearings, audits, and assessments, independently or along with advisors. · Prepare draft responses to notices, show cause notices (SCNs), and queries, and assist in filing appeals and replies at various appellate levels. · Coordinate with external tax consultants and legal counsel to support ongoing and potential GST litigation matters. 3. EOU, Customs & FTP Compliance · Manage EOU‑related compliances, including monitoring of positive Net Foreign Exchange (NFE), bond/LUT compliance, periodic filings, and renewals. · Oversee Customs and EOU documentation, duty exemptions, import/export compliance, and coordination with Customs, DGFT, and other authorities. · Ensure compliance with Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) provisions and EOU scheme conditions, including timely reporting and closure activities. · Support audits and departmental interactions relating to EOU and Customs matters. 4. Indirect Tax Accounting, Reporting & Controls · Support accurate GST accounting, provisioning, and reporting in coordination with Finance and Accounting teams. · Assist in preparation and review of tax disclosures related to Indirect Taxes for statutory and internal reporting. · Maintain robust documentation, audit trails, and control processes for Indirect Tax matters. · Drive continuous improvement in Indirect Tax processes, reconciliations, and compliance efficiency 5. Business & Stakeholder Support · Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Finance teams to assess GST and Customs implications of transactions such as imports, exports, job work, stock transfers, and inter‑unit supplies. · Provide practical guidance on Indirect Tax matters to internal stakeholders on day‑to‑day operational issues. · Support the Taxation Lead on special projects, reviews, and strategic initiatives related to Indirect Tax. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS · Qualified Chartered Accountant. · 4-6 years of hands‑on experience in Indirect Taxation, with strong exposure to GST compliance, audits, and litigation support. · Thorough working knowledge of GST law, rules, reconciliations, and departmental procedures. · Strong experience in EOU, Customs, and FTP‑related compliances. · Experience in preparing and handling GST notices, hearings, and appeals. · Proficiency in SAP (FI‑CO, MM, SD), Excel, and GST compliance tools. · Experience in pharmaceutical or manufacturing sector preferred PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in handling external stakeholders like Auditors, tax Authorities and other internal senior stakeholders. Very Good Understanding of GST & EOU related regulations and aspects thereof. Pharmaceutical Experience is preferred. Preferably should have worked in Global MNCs. Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
